shared_elements: procession of standing human figures in profile facing the same direction
tribute/gift bearers carrying vessels or objects
figures in long robes and in tunic-with-trousers dress
staff or spear held by a figure
low relief frieze in horizontal registers
justification: Both show the same highly specific scheme: horizontal relief registers of profile processions of delegates in varied dress bearing gifts, led by a staff-bearing usher, with animals led along and stylized conifer trees inserted as group dividers. The only differences are of framing and scope — A is a close view of one register with a camel and floral border rows, while B shows several stacked registers at a distance — with no substantive divergence in depicted content.
